subject: FLAG-14 directive
notes: kb/Work PB1374 (w1020f). cite.py --check 7.3.15.4 'If OFF is specified, flagging for the selected option or options is disabled' OK. OFF for explicitly selected options (a single option, several, explicit ALL OFF) already worked; `>>FLAG-14 OFF` is OFF with the implicitly selected ALL (the 5.2.6.3 default of the outer braces) and is now accepted: a bare `>>FLAG-14` followed by `>>FLAG-14 OFF` leaves VALUE-ZERO silent (Compile_Flag14_DefaultedBraces_SelectTheRightOptions).
